title: HandleMyFile
content_en:
Project Overview

HandleMyFile is a privacy-first, browser-native document processing workstation. It allows users to merge, split, compress, convert Office files, and perform OCR text extraction 100% locally in their browser without ever uploading sensitive documents to external servers.

The Challenge

Traditional online document tools force users to upload confidential files—such as financial records, contracts, and personal IDs—to third-party cloud servers, posing severe data privacy and compliance risks.

The Solution

Built with Next.js and compiled WebAssembly (Wasm) modules, HandleMyFile executes all file parsing, rendering, and conversion directly on the client edge in compliance with ISO 32000-2 standards. It provides instant processing speeds with zero bandwidth waste and zero privacy exposure.

Key Features

  • 100% Client-Side Processing: Zero server uploads; all operations run in-memory via WebAssembly.
  • Full Document Suite: Merge PDF, split pages, compress file size, convert Word/Excel, and extract text via OCR.
  • Multi-Language Support: Fully localized interface supporting over 30 languages.
  • Zero-Knowledge Architecture: Compliant with strict enterprise privacy and GDPR/HIPAA standards.

Ringkasan Proyek

HandleMyFile adalah workstation pemrosesan dokumen berbasis browser yang mengutamakan privasi. Memungkinkan pengguna menggabungkan, memisahkan, mengompresi, mengonversi file Office, dan mengekstrak teks via OCR 100% secara lokal di browser tanpa mengunggah dokumen sensitif ke server eksternal.

Tantangan

Alat dokumen online tradisional memaksa pengguna mengunggah file rahasia—seperti laporan keuangan, kontrak, dan KTP—ke server cloud pihak ketiga, yang menimbulkan risiko kebocoran privasi dan pelanggaran kepatuhan.

Solusi Teknis

Dibangun dengan Next.js dan modul WebAssembly (Wasm), HandleMyFile menjalankan semua parsing, rendering, dan konversi file langsung di sisi klien sesuai standar ISO 32000-2. Menghasilkan pemrosesan instan tanpa boros kuota dan tanpa risiko kebocoran data.

Fitur Utama

  • Pemrosesan 100% Client-Side: Tanpa upload ke server; semua operasi berjalan di memori browser via WebAssembly.
  • Suite Dokumen Lengkap: Gabung PDF, pisah halaman, kompres ukuran file, konversi Word/Excel, dan ekstrak teks OCR.
  • Dukungan Multi-Bahasa: Antarmuka terlokalisasi dalam lebih dari 30 bahasa.
  • Arsitektur Zero-Knowledge: Sesuai dengan standar privasi ketat untuk kebutuhan enterprise.
